quick_facts.label: What the job is
quick_facts.value: Software quality assurance analysts and testers develop and run software tests to find problems and their causes, document defects in a bug tracking system and report them to developers.

quick_facts.label: Other names for it
quick_facts.value: Job titles O*NET reports for this occupation (Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers) include Quality Assurance Engineer (QA Engineer), Software Quality Engineer, Automation Tester and Software Test Engineer.

quick_facts.label: Typical preparation
quick_facts.value: O*NET places this occupation in Job Zone Four (considerable preparation needed): most of these occupations require a four-year bachelor's degree, but some do not.

sections.heading: What a software QA engineer does
paragraphs: Software quality assurance analysts and testers develop and run software tests to find problems and their causes, document defects in a bug tracking system and report them to developers.

The tasks below are taken from the O*NET profile for Software Quality Assurance Analysts and Testers. O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Design test plans, scenarios, scripts and procedures.
Identify, analyse and document problems with how a program works or what it shows.
Record software defects in a bug tracking system and report them to developers.
Give developers feedback on software usability and functionality.

sections.heading: How people get into this job
paragraphs: O*NET places this occupation in Job Zone Four (considerable preparation needed): most of these occupations require a four-year bachelor's degree, but some do not.
In India, the UGC specification of degrees lists B.Tech and B.E. as four-year bachelor's degrees entered after 10+2.
O*NET is the US Department of Labor's occupation database, so this describes the job as it is profiled in the United States; titles and duties in Indian companies can differ.
bullets: Common routes into this job on the Career Tree map: B.Tech in Computer Science and Engineering; BCA (Bachelor of Computer Applications); MCA (Master of Computer Applications).
